name: mcp-server-localrydes
description: Search chauffeur vehicles, create reservations, and check booking payment status.

interface.longDescription: Search chauffeur vehicle availability for a route and date, compare returned options and prices, create a reservation after confirmation, and check the payment status of an existing booking.
defaultPrompt: Find a chauffeur vehicle for my next trip.
Compare Localrydes vehicle options for a route.
Check the payment status of my booking.

positive.description: Search for a point-to-point airport transfer and show only vehicles returned by Localrydes.
positive.prompt: Find a chauffeur vehicle from Vienna International Airport to Hotel Sacher Vienna on 20 October 2026 at 14:30 for 2 passengers with 2 bags.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_vehicles with the route, date, time, passenger count, and bag count, then report only returned availability and pricing.

positive.description: Search for an hourly chauffeur without sending a drop-off location.
positive.prompt: Find an hourly chauffeur departing from Hotel Sacher Vienna on 22 October 2026 at 09:00 for 1 passenger with no bags.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_vehicles with hourly service, omit the drop-off location, and display the returned vehicle options and prices.

positive.description: Search for vehicles and select the cheapest returned Business-class option without creating a booking.
positive.prompt: Find a transfer from Zurich Airport to Zurich city centre on 25 October 2026 at 16:00 for 2 passengers with 2 bags, then select the cheapest available Business-class vehicle, but do not book it.
positive.expected_behavior: Search first, select only a vehicle returned by the search, and report the selected vehicle and final price without creating a booking.

positive.description: Complete the search, selection, and explicitly confirmed reservation workflow.
positive.prompt: Find the cheapest transfer from Munich Airport to Hotel Bayerischer Hof on 28 October 2026 at 11:00 for 1 passenger with 1 bag, select it, and book it for Alex Example, alex@example.com, +43123456789. I explicitly confirm that you may create the reservation.
positive.expected_behavior: Search before selecting, use identifiers returned by the server, create the reservation only after confirmation, and return the supplied reservation ID and payment link.

positive.description: Look up a booking ID and report only the status information returned by Localrydes.
positive.prompt: Check the current payment status of booking LR1054321.
positive.expected_behavior: Call booking_status with the supplied booking ID and report the returned status, or clearly report a not-found response without inventing data.

negative.description: A transfer request is missing its required drop-off location.
negative.prompt: Find me a transfer from Vienna International Airport on 20 October 2026 at 14:30 for 2 passengers.

negative.description: A user requests immediate booking before any search, vehicle selection, or confirmation.
negative.prompt: Create a booking immediately with any available car for Alex Example at alex@example.com.

negative.description: The request is for an unsupported flight booking rather than chauffeur transportation.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from Vienna to London next Friday.

review.commerce_description: The plugin creates chauffeur-service reservations and returns an external payment URL; payment is completed outside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.1 adds required listing links and icons, uses capability-based listing text, and supplies complete review test cases.
